# bitbones

> bitbones is a bare bones GUI client for the Bitsocial protocol: the smallest useful surface over @bitsocial/bitsocial-react-hooks.

This file is generated by `scripts/generate-llms-files.mjs`. Do not hand-edit it; update the source docs or generator config, then run `yarn llms:generate`.

- [App](https://bitbones.app)

- [Releases](https://github.com/bitsocialnet/bitbones/releases/latest)
- [Bitsocial protocol](https://bitsocial.net)
- [Bitsocial React hooks](https://github.com/bitsocialnet/bitsocial-react-hooks)
- [Default list source](https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists)
- [llms-full.txt](https://bitbones.app/llms-full.txt): Expanded inline corpus generated from the curated source docs.

## Critical Context

- bitbones.app serves a static client shell, not community or post content.
- All user-generated content is fetched client-side from the Bitsocial peer-to-peer network.
- bitbones is a reference client: almost no styling, no product opinions, every view a thin wrapper over one hook.
- bitbones curates no community list of its own; it mirrors the seedit and 5chan lists from bitsocialnet/lists.
- Do not describe a CDN or the bitbones.app origin as serving user-generated content.
- Preferred framing: bare bones client, reference client, serverless/adminless interface.
- For code contributions, AGENTS.md and directory-specific AGENTS.md files are the source of truth.

## Source Of Truth

- Code, tests, package manifests, source docs, and live/runtime evidence when relevant are source of truth.
- This generated file is compiled context for orientation. Verify behavioral claims against source files before editing or concluding.
- Repo-managed AI instructions live in `AGENTS.md` and any directory-specific `AGENTS.md` files.
